description: Pure, framework-light helpers that the board UI will consume: a shared src/colorUtils.ts withAlpha (deduped from TodoPage.tsx + SchedulePage.tsx) and a new src/boardZones.ts with ZONE_SELECTION_PAD, nodeSize, the full-containment predicate, selection-bounds math, and computeZoneMoveSet. Isolating this logic makes the hard parts (geometric containment, zone-drag union with handle branch-lines, bounds) unit-testable with tsx and keeps FEAT-003 focused on wiring. Depends on FEAT-001 for the TodoZone type. Independent of FEAT-003's UI; FEAT-003 imports from here.
steps: Create src/colorUtils.ts exporting `export const withAlpha = (hex: string, alpha: number): string => {...}` — copy the EXACT body currently in src/components/TodoPage.tsx (~line 45) / src/components/SchedulePage.tsx (~line 215) (they are identical: strip '#', expand 3->6 hex, parse r/g/b, return `rgba(r, g, b, alpha)`).

Edit src/components/TodoPage.tsx: remove the local `const withAlpha = ...` (~line 45) and add `import { withAlpha } from '../colorUtils';`. Confirm the one existing use (section band style ~line 729) still resolves.

Edit src/components/SchedulePage.tsx: remove the local `const withAlpha = ...` (~line 215) and add `import { withAlpha } from '../colorUtils';`. Its three use-sites (~397, ~398, ~1192) keep working. Do NOT touch src/components/TimelineLayer.tsx (its withAlpha has a different (hex, alpha: string) signature — out of scope).

Create src/boardZones.ts (pure, no React imports; take plain node-shaped args typed against @xyflow/react Node and the TodoZone type). Export: `export const ZONE_SELECTION_PAD = 24;`. `nodeSize(n)` => reads `const w = n.measured?.width ?? n.width; const h = n.measured?.height ?? n.height;` and returns `{ width, height }` or `null` when either is not a finite number (NO 176x96 fallback). `inside(n, Z)` => full rectangle-containment using nodeSize(n); returns false if nodeSize is null (unmeasured => excluded). A bounds helper computing the selection rectangle from the measured nodes padded by ZONE_SELECTION_PAD (x/y = min-PAD, width/height = span + 2*PAD). `computeZoneMoveSet(zone, nodes, membersByHead)` => base = nodes inside(zone); for each base node with isHandle, union membersByHead.get(id) (a Set, may include nodes outside the rect); return the deduped union set of ids (base ∪ branch).
Keep boardZones.ts free of store/React-Flow-runtime imports so `npx tsx` can import and exercise it directly with hand-built node objects.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` exits 0; no local withAlpha definition remains in TodoPage.tsx or SchedulePage.tsx (both import from colorUtils); TimelineLayer.tsx unchanged.
nodeSize returns measured dims when present, falls back to n.width/height, and returns null when neither is a finite number.

inside() treats a fully-contained node as a member, an edge-straddling node as a non-member, a legacy node measured 176x48 by its real 48 height (not the 96 default), and an unmeasured node (measured + width/height all undefined) as a non-member.
computeZoneMoveSet returns base ∪ (branch-lines of handles inside), includes branch nodes lying outside the zone rect, dedupes, and returns an empty set for a zone with nothing inside.
The selection-bounds helper uses ZONE_SELECTION_PAD (= 24) on all four sides.
verification: Write a temp script (e.g. .agents/tasks/_tmp_feat002.ts) importing from ../../../src/boardZones (adjust relative path) that builds hand-made node objects and a membersByHead Map and asserts: full-containment include/exclude incl. the 176x48 legacy and unmeasured cases; computeZoneMoveSet union-with-handle-branch-lines (handle inside pulls an out-of-rect branch node) + dedupe + empty-zone; bounds math uses pad 24. Run `npx tsx` on it, confirm assertions pass, then delete it.
Record in `findings` the final exported names/signatures of boardZones.ts so FEAT-003 imports them correctly.
findings:
Created src/colorUtils.ts: `export const withAlpha = (hex: string, alpha: number): string` (3->6 hex expansion variant from TodoPage). TodoPage.tsx and SchedulePage.tsx now import it; local copies removed; TimelineLayer.tsx untouched.

Created src/boardZones.ts (pure; only type-only imports of `Node` from '@xyflow/react' and `TodoZone` from './types' — no store/React runtime). FEAT-003 should import:
- `export const ZONE_SELECTION_PAD = 24;`
- `export interface Rect { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; }`
- `export const nodeSize = (n: Pick<Node,'measured'|'width'|'height'>) => { width: number; height: number } | null` — prefers measured, falls back to n.width/n.height, returns null if either dim is not finite (NO 176x96 fallback).
- `export const inside = (n: Pick<Node,'position'|'measured'|'width'|'height'>, Z: TodoZone) => boolean` — full rectangle containment via nodeSize; null size => false.
- `export const selectionBounds = (nodes: Array<Pick<Node,'position'|'measured'|'width'|'height'>>) => Rect | null` — min/max of measured footprints padded by ZONE_SELECTION_PAD on all four sides; null when no node has a resolvable size.
- `export const computeZoneMoveSet = (zone: TodoZone, nodes: Array<Pick<Node,'id'|'position'|'measured'|'width'|'height'> & { data?: { isHandle?: boolean } }>, membersByHead: Map<string, Set<string>>) => Set<string>` — base = nodes inside(zone); for each base node with data.isHandle===true, union membersByHead.get(id) (may include out-of-rect ids); deduped; empty zone => empty set.

Verification: `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit) exits 0. A throwaway tsx harness asserted nodeSize (measured/fallback/null incl. partial), inside (contained/straddling/legacy-176x48-by-real-48-height/unmeasured-excluded), selectionBounds (pad 24 on all sides, null when no footprint), and computeZoneMoveSet (union with handle branch-lines incl. out-of-rect node, dedupe, non-member excluded, empty zone). Harness deleted after passing.
